subject: general
question: The 15th Finance Commission has been constituted by the President of India for a period of ______ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**five**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 15th Finance commission **was established to make recommendations for a** five-year period beginning on April 1, 2020**.
 
• The commission's major goals were to **"strengthen cooperative federalism, increase the quality of government spending, and contribute to fiscal stability."**
 
• The Government of India established the Fifteenth Finance Commission in November 2017 after receiving assent from the President of India through a notification in the Indian Gazette.
 
• The commission's chairman is **Nand Kishore Singh**, and its full-time members are** Shaktikanta Das **and **Anoop Singh**, with part-time members Ramesh Chand and Ashok Lahiri.
 
• Shaktikanta Das, who resigned from the commission to become the governor of the Reserve Bank of India, was replaced by **Ajay Narayan Jha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• **The Finance Commissions** are commissions appointed by the President of India on a regular basis under **Article 280 of the Indian Constitution** to define the financial connections between the central government and state governments.
 
• The** Finance Commission Act of 1951** constituted the** First Commission 1951**.
 
• The most current Finance Commission, chaired by** N. K. Singh,** a former member of the Planning Commission, was established in 2017.
 
• The Commission is appointed every five years, according to the Constitution, and consists of a chairperson and four additional members.
